arxiv-2301-05378.title: Dynamical signatures of the Liouvillian Flat Band
arxiv-2301-05378.creator: Yu-Guo Liu, Shu Chen
arxiv-2301-05378.description: Abstract Although flat-band structures have been the subject of intensive studies in condensed-matter and optical physics due to their eigenstates, which exhibit huge degeneracy and allow for the localization of wave packets, it is not clear how the Liouvillian flat band influences the relaxation dynamics of open quantum systems.

arxiv-2303-10262.title: Estimation of Unknown Payoff Parameters in Large Network Games
arxiv-2303-10262.creator: Feras Al Taha, Francesca Parise
arxiv-2303-10262.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Feras Al Taha, Francesca Parise. We consider network games where a large number of agents interact according to a network sampled from a random network model, represented by a graphon. By exploiting previous results on convergence of such large network games to graphon games, we examine a procedure for estimating unknown payoff parameters, from observations of equilibrium actions, without the need for exact network information. We prove smoothness and local convexity of the optimization problem involved in computing the proposed estimator.

arxiv-2306-02655.title: Quantum Valley and Sub-valley Hall Effect in the Large Angle Twisted Bilayer Graphene
arxiv-2306-02655.creator: Chiranjit Mondal, Rasoul Ghadimi, Bohm-Jung Yang
arxiv-2306-02655.description: Abstract We study the quantum valley Hall effect and related domain wall modes in twisted bilayer graphene at a large commensurate angle. Due to the quantum valley and sub-valley Hall effect, a small deviation from the commensurate angle generates two-dimensional conducting network patterns composed of one-dimensional domain walls, which can host non-Fermi liquid behavior within an accessible temperature range.

arxiv-2403-16968.title: Evaluating Shortest Edit Script Methods for Contextual Lemmatization
arxiv-2403-16968.description: Abstract Modern contextual lemmatizers often rely on automatically induced Shortest Edit Scripts (SES), namely, the number of edit operations to transform a word form into its lemma. In fact, different methods of computing SES have been proposed as an integral component in the architecture of several state-of-the-art contextual lemmatizers currently available.

arxiv-2503-03646.title: Efektywne energetycznie wielodostępowe przetwarzanie brzegowe w sieci 5G
arxiv-2503-03646.creator: Energy efficient Multi-access Edge Computing in 5G network
arxiv-2503-03646.description: Abstract KONFERENCJA RADIOKOMUNIKACJI I TELEINFORMATYKI KRiT 2024 Streszczenie: Wielodostępowe przetwarzanie brzegowe jest techniką łączącą wykorzystanie sieci komunikacyjnych i oddalonych zasobów obliczeniowych. Pozwala wykonać złożone zadania obliczeniowe na potrzeby urządzeń o niewielkiej mocy obliczeniowej przy zachowaniu niewielkich opóźnień. Istotne jest jednak efektywne zarządzanie przydziałem zadań obliczeniowych do poszczególnych węzłów.

arxiv-2503-14660.title: Heuristic and Optimal Synthesis of CNOT and Clifford Circuits
arxiv-2503-14660.creator: Mark Webster, Stergios Koutsioumpas, Dan E Browne
arxiv-2503-14660.description: Abstract Efficiently implementing Clifford circuits is crucial for quantum error correction and quantum algorithms. Linear reversible circuits, equivalent to circuits composed of CNOT gates, have important applications in classical computing. In this work we present methods for CNOT and general Clifford circuit synthesis which can be used to minimise either the entangling two-qubit gate count or the circuit depth.
